stem: A printing store used 24 ounces of ink in 18 minutes. Which graph has a slope that best represents the average number of ounces of ink used per minute?

options.text: Printer Ink Used in a Store (graph showing slope about 1.4 oz/min)

options.label: C
options.text: Printer Ink Used in a Store (graph showing slope about 1.6 oz/min)

options.label: D
options.text: Printer Ink Used in a Store (graph showing slope about 2.2 oz/min)

visual_elements: Four graphs labeled A, B, C, D each titled 'Printer Ink Used in a Store' with y-axis 'Amount of Ink (oz)' and x-axis 'Time (min)'. Each graph shows a line starting at (0,0) with different slopes.
